description: This file defines the OAuthAccessToken entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_oauth2_access_token' database table. It includes properties such as access token, client ID, user ID, expiry date/time, and revoked status, along with getters and setters.

classes.name: OAuthAccessToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth access tokens, with database mapping annotations, properties, and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the access token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the access token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time as a DateTimeImmutable object in UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
